lift.doc: Shadow lift: c·gain + lift·(1 − c); positive values lift blacks, negative values crush them

gamma.doc: Midtones: c^(1/gamma); values greater than 1 brighten the midtones

saturation.doc: Saturation: linear blend with Rec.601 luminance (0.299, 0.587, 0.114); 0 = gray, 1 = unchanged

tint.doc: Colour temperature shift: +1 warm (orange), −1 cool (blue), implemented as luminance-preserving channel multipliers

shoulder.doc: Highlight shoulder: above the knee at 1 − 0.6·shoulder, exponential soft compression; 0 = hard clip

doc: Grade: un-premultiply to f64, per-channel gamma → gain/lift → shoulder compression, then saturation and colour temperature multipliers, clamped to 0..1, then multiplied back by alpha and rounded. pow / exp go through libm, bit-identical between native and wasm. All six parameters are scalars and can be keyframed through the effects[i].<param> channels (§6.6).
